jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the product narrative. Define what it is, what it enables, and why it matters. Connect capabilities to business value: what the enterprise gets, not what the product does. Keep it sharp against a fast-moving competitive field and coherent with the Wonderful platform story.

 - Deliver stories in every format. Product videos of every type: launch films, feature walkthroughs, demo narrations. Plus release notes, web copy, and sales narratives. You write the script and the one-liner.

 - Find stories. Find them in the product, in deployments, in customers. The best material isn't handed to you; you go dig it out from product and field teams.

 - Build enablement and sales materials. Decks, one-pagers, battle cards, demo scripts. Build them, maintain them, keep them the single source of truth.

 - Break down for industries and buyers. Adapt the product’s core messaging for specific verticals and for business, technical, and risk buyers.

 - Work AI-first. AI is embedded in how this team operates. You'll use it daily and help design how.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of B2B product marketing, ideally with a technical product.

 - Truth seeking. You dig into what the product actually does and what customers actually experience, and you make sure the messaging reflects it.

 - Proven ability to develop positioning and turn it into sales-facing and customer-facing assets.

 - Range across formats: video scripts, release notes, positioning docs, web, enablement.

 - Depth over breadth: you can go deep on one product and become its foremost internal expert.

 - Fluency with AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as an afterthought.

 - Comfort in an early-stage, fast-paced environment. Things move quickly here.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own and drive the end-to-end lifecycle of Wonderful's AI OS components: from ideation and design through production launch, and continuous iteration based on real customer usage.

 - Partner closely with engineering, forward-deployed teams, and enterprise customers. Turn what you learn into decisions of what actually makes an agent reliable or a deployment succeed.

 - Define and own the metrics that matter for each product, and use them to continuously adjust strategy for maximum impact and growth.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years of product management experience in hyper-growth tech companies, ideally with some exposure to AI/ML or agentic products.

 - Highly analytical, with a proven track record of investigating reality over opinion, and using it to drive prioritization and strategic decisions.

 - Genuine passion for AI, comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced environments.

 - Strong technical fluency, comfortable discussing tradeoffs with engineers.

 - Exceptional problem-solving skills, a proactive, ownership-driven mindset, and the instinct to build the frameworks that keep a fast-moving team focused.
